_comment: Inventory of third-party libraries vendored into auditable.html / works.html
at build time. build.js reads this + each entry's licenseFile and injects
__BUILD_LICENSES__ at build time. init.js then mounts /sys/licenses/ from
that constant — so the runtime's Licenses tab and About dialog can surface
what the binary is actually built from.
Only one entry per distinct vendored ARTIFACT is needed (e.g. cm6 covers
the whole CodeMirror 6 / Lezer tree because the bundle ships as one .min.js).
licenseFile paths are repo-relative. Tolerated-missing: if the file isn't
there at build time (e.g. cm6/acorn LICENSEs live in their node_modules,
which is gitignored), build warns but proceeds with metadata-only.
To add an entry: pick a stable name, fill in spdx/version/homepage,
commit the LICENSE text under vendor-licenses/<name>.txt (or reference an

codemirror.description: CodeMirror 6 — the editor for every code/markdown/html cell. Bundled at ext/cm6/cm6.min.js (rollup build from npm packages: codemirror, @codemirror/*, @lezer/highlight).

katex.description: KaTeX — TeX math rendering. Vendored at ext/katex/index.js (UMD wrapped as @gcu/katex) in MathML-only mode: the browser renders math with system math fonts, so NO KaTeX fonts/CSS are shipped (~265KB engine only). Used by the book reader surface.

qrcode-generator.description: QR Code Generator for JavaScript (Kazuhiko Arase) — byte-mode + UTF-8 QR encoding. Vendored at ext/qr/index.js (wrapped as @gcu/qr with a GCU SVG renderer). Used by the Library surface's Share action to make capsule QR codes.

acorn.description: JavaScript parser used by @gcu/air to lower cell sources into the AIR intermediate representation. acorn-typescript plugin enables AIR's type-annotation parsing. Bundled at ext/acorn/acorn.min.js.

openlayers.description: Map rendering library used by @gcu/spinifex (geospatial cells). Vendored at ext/spinifex/vendor/ol.min.js — only ships in builds that include spinifex.

xterm.description: Terminal emulator. Vendored at ext/rv/vendor/xterm.min.js + addon-fit.min.js. Used by the Works shell terminal surface and the rv (RISC-V) emulator.

switchboard-fonts.description: Sans-serif (Barlow) and monospace (Space Mono) font families used in the GCU typography stack. Only bundled when works.html is built or when the user opts in to 'embed fonts' in auditable.html.

fflate.description: DEFLATE / ZIP / gzip / zlib codec used by @gcu/archive for ZIP read/write and as the underlying compressor for archive.compress's deflate paths. Vendored at ext/archive/vendor/fflate.module.mjs — only ships in builds that bundle @gcu/archive.

fzstd.description: Zstandard decoder used by @gcu/archive for .zst / .tar.zst read. Decode-only — see ext/archive/SPEC §8 for why encode is out of scope. Vendored at ext/archive/vendor/fzstd.module.mjs.

xz-decompress.description: XZ / LZMA2 streaming decoder used by @gcu/archive for .xz / .tar.xz read. WebAssembly-based (~20 KB with the Wasm payload inlined as base64). Decode-only — see SPEC §8. Vendored at ext/archive/vendor/xz-decompress.module.mjs. Bundles xz-embedded (public domain) and walloc (MIT) — full attribution in LICENSE-xz-decompress.

seek-bzip.description: Pure-JS bzip2 decoder used by @gcu/archive for .bz2 / .tar.bz2 read. Decode-only — see SPEC §8. Concatenated from 4 upstream CommonJS files into a single ESM bundle at ext/archive/vendor/seek-bzip.module.mjs (regenerable via the header comment's vendoring notes).

wasm4.description: The WASM-4 fantasy console's 8×8 system font — a DATA asset (1792 bytes, 224 glyphs 0x20-0xFF) extracted from the native runtime's font[] array (runtimes/native/src/framebuffer.c) and baked into @gcu/wasm4 (ext/wasm4/font.js). Used so the wasm4 surface renders real carts' text() with faithful glyph metrics. No upstream code is vendored — the rasterizer/host/APU are first-party (SPEC-wasm4 §7).

cpython-stdlib.description: CPython standard-library modules carried verbatim as adder frozen modules (ext/adder/pylib/: html/parser.py, _markupbase.py), embedded into the adder bundle by ext/adder/gen-pylib.js.
